sample_unit: members screened for HCV antibodies in prospective outreach

links.outcome: HCV carriers identified per number screened, ML-targeted outreach versus concurrent USPSTF-eligible testing
links.effect: ML outreach: 477 screened, 38 active carriers, NNS 10. USPSTF-eligible testing: 53,403 tested, 38 carriers, NNS 1029. Over 100-fold greater efficiency.
links.quote: Among the 53,403 USPSTF screening–eligible members who were tested over the same period, 38 were found to be active HCV carriers, yielding an NNS of 1029.

unlisted_practices: Using ML risk prediction to target screening outreach to high-risk individuals instead of population-wide guideline-based screening

screen.reason: Evaluates a prospective real-world deployment of an ML-driven targeted screening and outreach program versus standard population screening.
